spec_evidence.checked: Cached stripe OAS snapshots (openapi/spec3.json): in v2248 the payment-record alma details reference the shared alma_installments schema whose count property is a required, non-nullable integer. In v2249 the payment-record surfaces switch to a dedicated projection schema (payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_payment_method_alma_details_resource_installments) where count carries nullable:true. The shared alma_installments schema used by charges/payment_intents is unchanged; only the payment_records / payment_attempt_records read surfaces are affected. Nine records are projections of this single schema change across the nine operations.

fix.migration_guide: payment_method_details.alma.installments.count on payment record and payment attempt record responses can now be null. Code that does arithmetic on it, formats it, or asserts it is a number can receive null. Add a null guard at each read site and decide the business fallback (treat as single installment, skip installment display, or surface unknown).
